The maximum resistance is 500lbs. 2.Can use large hole barbell piece, can also use small hole barbell piece. 3.there are 10 adjustment around the rotating arm, 4 adjustment forward and backward adjustment, You can exercise the whole body muscle group. 4.the bottom tube is set with the bench SF-BH622045 connection position, combined use can complete the pull down, push the chest, push the shoulder, rowing and other functions. 5.equipped with multi-functional accessories to meet the different needs of users, multi-connection ring pull, can be designed according to the needs of the pull length.Push rod, can achieve chest push, rowing and other functions.Ankle strap accessories can be used for leg and hip muscles. 6.the main frame is equipped with 4 multi-functional hooks to meet the user's placement of accessories and small items.It is equipped with two left and right barbell hanging rods to place unused barbell pieces.
